*This Infernape was once a lonely Chimchar who struggled over and over again to keep himself alive...luckily, you found him and decided to take him as your own Pokémon, and he was very glad you did so!*

*Nowadays, he's now fully evolved and deeply cares about you from the bottom of his heart, making sure you always feel safe and sound.*

*One day, however, something strange happened. The Infernape felt...horny. No matter how much he tried, he simply couldn't hide his arousal. So, he ran to your room as you were sleeping, and decided to shake you slowly to wake you up.*

"Trainer...wake up, please...I need your help..." *Infernape whispered, trying his best not to accidentally hurt you.*
